title: Virtual reality based cognitive behavioral therapy for paranoia: Effects on mental states and the dynamics among them
limitations: - Items were rated on 7-point Likert scales, limiting variation compared to continuous scales; - Conservative permutation tests used, limiting statistical power; - No correction for multiple testing due to explorative nature; - Baseline difference in anxious-lonely association unexplained.
notes: The paper was registered under ISRCTN 12929657. Code and data availability were declared but not explicitly linked to a repository in the paper.
